svg.aria-label: Four panels, for the squares C, W, D and S. Each shows the axes of the frame of its square dashed, the first pointing right and the second up, the unit circle, and an arrow for the unit force that each separating inequality puts on the square, labelled (D.1) to (D.9) and coloured by the other square of the separation: blue for W, purple for D, green for S and black for C
